scope: Six focused decisions over five existing catalog identities and one proposed conditional identity. Eight pinned source files reviewed in selected sections plus six license files and primary documentation. Identity/lifetime contracts only; no full-repository audit, whole-landscape ranking or native data acceptance.

review_boundaries.activities: Public source/license/documentation reads and existing catalog inspection only.
review_boundaries.excluded: No credential reads, account/market-data API requests, dataset downloads, installs, model calls, purchases or broker actions.
review_boundaries.metadata_method: Unauthenticated GitHub repository/default-branch commit and pinned license metadata; selected raw source files fetched at exact commits. Branch heads describe review time, not installed versions.

prior_star_refresh.scope: Complete identity refresh previously recorded; it does not imply all 342 repositories received a source audit.

temporal_contract.security_identity: Provider-scoped stable security identity, separate from company identity and current ticker.
temporal_contract.symbol_validity: Dates over which a symbol refers to that security; a rename is not necessarily a new security.
temporal_contract.vendor_revision: Dataset vintage and record revision/availability, including mapping updates after the economic event.
temporal_contract.local_observation: When this acquisition actually received each response. Unknown historical first observation stays unknown.

rename_probe_recommendation.owner: Coordinator; independent native plan/receipt is authoritative

current_asset_lookup.scope: Current UUID/status/tradability snapshot only; do not infer UUID continuity across rename from one current lookup.

acceptance: Freeze plan and source hashes before acquisition; retain all pages, queries, local observation times and final pagination status.
Compare mapped-case timestamps and raw numeric rows after separating response ticker labels; compare the corresponding symbol-only subsets.
Treat missing/unexpected rows, unsupported parameter behavior or unexhausted pagination as explicit unresolved findings, not a retuned expectation.
Keep current asset status separate from historical rows; no orders, profitability, complete-universe or historically as-known claim.
rename_probe_recommendation.availability_caveat: Alpaca FAQ states FB/META mapping was available June 10, the day after the effective rename. Today's reconstructed mapping is not evidence that it existed on June 9.

event_context.scope: Historical company announcement context only. Present-day source review does not reconstruct original API or local first-observed availability.

reviewed_files.reviewed_scope: get_all_assets and get_asset request construction, lines 376–418

decisions.role: Current Alpaca asset lookup and historical ticker mapping
strengths: GetAssetsRequest and TradingClient separate current asset enumeration/lookup from historical market-data requests. The current Assets API documents all statuses by default and filters for status, asset class, exchange and attributes.

Historical bars asof chooses the entity associated with the queried ticker on that date. '-' disables mapping; a ticker not found for asof falls back to symbol-only. Explicit mapping is suitable for a bounded rename continuity check.
limits: Current asset UUID/status/tradable fields do not establish past tradability, a complete historical universe, all delistings or original mapping availability. This interface documents no historical asset-list asof parameter.
Alpaca's FAQ says FB-to-META mapping became available June 10, one day after the June 9 rename. Today's reconstructed continuity must not become a June 9 as-known signal.
Current SDK source review is not an upgrade: the selected native runtime remains alpaca-py 0.44.0. REST/SDK drift and actual data entitlement remain separate acceptance checks.
Apache-2.0 covers the client, not SIP market-data access or redistribution rights.
native_api_shapes_not_executed: StockHistoricalDataClient.get_stock_bars(StockBarsRequest(symbol_or_symbols='META', timeframe=TimeFrame.Day, start=START_UTC, end=END_UTC, feed=DataFeed.SIP, adjustment=Adjustment.RAW, asof='2022-06-10'))
decisions.next_bounded_acceptance: Coordinator's frozen four-case June 8–10 2022 rename probe plus exactly one current META asset lookup. Raw request pagination is separately bounded; the high-level SDK method shown here is not a page-budget implementation.
decisions.selection_effect: Retain the selected client; native execution and its receipt belong to the coordinator's separate identity-readiness task.

reviewed_files.reviewed_scope: lookup_symbol date/ambiguity contract, lines 930–989; lifetimes inclusion rules, lines 1419–1474

decisions.role: Dated ticker ownership and equity lifetime masking
strengths: AssetFinder.lookup_symbol accepts as_of_date and country_code with fuzzy=False. An omitted date resolves only unambiguous ownership; reused symbols can raise ambiguity instead of silently selecting a present-day owner.
lifetimes provides per-date asset masks and explicit start-date inclusion, addressing the first-session close being unavailable that morning.
limits: Results depend on the ingested asset database and bundle. Local sids, start/end bounds and name histories are not an independently complete historical US-equities master.
Lookup dates and lifetime masks do not supply vendor revisions, original observation times, halted-session status or data rights.
decisions.next_bounded_acceptance: If an independent identity oracle is needed, use a tiny synthetic asset database with two disjoint owners of one ticker, a gap, overlapping/ambiguous ownership and first/last session boundaries. Assert lookup errors and dated masks; label it fixture behavior, not real historical-universe acceptance.
decisions.selection_effect: No second production engine added. Retain as a focused correctness reference for symbol reuse and lifetime boundaries.

reviewed_files.reviewed_scope: InstrumentProvider list_instruments contract, lines 267–286; LocalInstrumentProvider span clipping and as_list conversion, lines 678–723

decisions.role: Research universe spans separate from PIT factor storage
strengths: LocalInstrumentProvider clips stored instrument spans to the requested interval and retains nonempty spans. as_list=False preserves those spans for per-date membership evaluation.
limits: as_list=True returns only the union of surviving keys over the query interval; treating that union as membership on every date leaks future listings.
Stored spans require upstream listing/delisting provenance. They are not proof of contemporary observation or comprehensive US coverage.

The prior PIT factor review is a separate capability: publication/revision-aware factors do not make the instrument universe as-known. Existing upstream PIT tests acquire China fixtures and were not run here.
decisions.next_bounded_acceptance: Only against an already initialized local provider, compare stored spans with per-session expected inclusion across one synthetic listing and one delisting. Keep observation/revision timestamps in a separate provenance table; do not download a new Qlib dataset.
decisions.selection_effect: Keep research candidate status; current gap is source provenance, not a replacement factor engine.

reviewed_files.reviewed_scope: Equity identity/raw symbol/optional ISIN/event and initialization fields, lines 38–110; equality by instrument id, lines 205–211
Symbol/venue identity fields, new/from_as_ref and parsing, lines 38–150

decisions.role: Execution instrument identity and explicit event/object timestamps
strengths: InstrumentId consists of symbol plus venue. Equity additionally records raw_symbol, optional ISIN, ts_event and ts_init; equity equality uses its instrument id.
limits: Symbol/venue identity does not by itself resolve ticker reuse or changing tickers to one permanent historical security. ISIN is optional.
ts_event is the supplied event time; ts_init is object initialization time. Neither guarantees vendor first publication or a complete historical instrument master.
Reviewed develop HEAD now uses Rust model paths; earlier Cython paths returned 404. This source review does not replace the catalog's previously selected release or prove Python API compatibility.
LGPL-3.0 code obligations and provider/venue data rights are separate.
decisions.next_bounded_acceptance: For a future pinned runtime adoption, build two explicit FB/META instrument records and retain their differing ids plus a separately proven stable-security mapping. Confirm supplied event/init timestamps survive serialization. This source task does not compile or run the new develop layout.
decisions.selection_effect: Retain the existing runtime candidate, without representing an execution model as the missing historical identity dataset.

reviewed_files.reviewed_scope: FirstDate/DelistingDate and empty-map defaults, lines 44–86; GetMappedSymbol/HasData, lines 106–139

decisions.role: Historical ticker map boundaries in the selected simulator
strengths: MapFile derives FirstDate and DelistingDate from its first/last sorted rows and GetMappedSymbol chooses the first compatible row whose date is at or after the query date.
HasData bounds a populated map by those endpoint dates, supporting explicit before/inside/after tests.
limits: An empty map uses beginning/end-of-time sentinels and HasData returns true. Therefore HasData alone is not evidence that bars or a valid historical universe exist.
A final map sentinel is not an observed delisting. Current map/factor files can be retrospective; first availability and revisions remain unproven.
Prior accepted AAPL native factor/map proof remains limited to its frozen sample. The broad upstream NUnit fixture was unresolved; this source review adds no new native pass.
decisions.next_bounded_acceptance: Reuse the existing isolated LEAN API recipe only if needed: populated and empty map fixtures, dates before/at/after a rename and bounds, with explicit sentinel handling. Require separate bar existence and source-observation evidence before treating any result as coverage.
decisions.selection_effect: Retain LEAN. Add coverage/provenance guards around supplied data instead of changing the simulation engine.

reviewed_files.reviewed_scope: list_tables and schema permissions, lines 400–418; describe_table, lines 446–472; raw_sql precision/parameters/chunks, lines 499–533

decisions.role: Optional WRDS access bridge to licensed CRSP identity, lifecycle and delisting research data
strengths: CRSP documents PERMNO as a permanent security identifier; PERMCO identifies the company. Its historical stock data includes identity histories, distributions and delisting information.

The WRDS Python client exposes permission-checked table discovery, column inspection and parameterized SQL. coerce_float=False avoids the documented default precision conversion when retaining exact decimal metadata.
limits: BSD-3-Clause licenses the client only. WRDS access and CRSP subscriptions, permitted use and redistribution require separate entitlement; none was requested or exercised.

Current CRSP data uses the CIZ transition. The final legacy SIZ release was December 2024 data released in February 2025. Inspect entitled tables and definitions; do not assume a legacy table name or transplant delisting-return formulas.

Permanent ids and a current research dataset vintage do not establish what our strategy knew at each decision. Retain dataset/release vintage, symbol validity, revision and observation metadata separately.

The public legacy demo documents missing delisting-value codes; a missing outcome must remain explicit rather than silently become zero. Demo metadata is not proof of current CIZ schema or free full-universe access.
decisions.next_bounded_acceptance: Only if existing rights are later confirmed: inspect a chosen entitled schema, freeze its CIZ/vintage definitions and three known lifecycle cases (rename, delisting, ticker reuse), then execute a bounded parameterized query. Preserve unknown outcomes and compare identity/validity intervals, not strategy returns.
decisions.selection_effect: One new conditional catalog identity for a distinct licensed benchmark/access role; no install, subscription, replacement price feed or immediate blocker introduced.

retained_discovery_failures.resolution: Located and reviewed current Rust source paths at the same commit; no fallback to old Cython source or install.

recommendation.selected_minimal_path: Retain Alpaca-py acquisition, DuckDB revision/provenance storage and LEAN map/simulation semantics; retain EdgarTools for filing provenance. Advance the frozen rename probe before larger universe work.
recommendation.next_gate: A bounded rename pass checks these historical symbol-query/mapping responses only. It does not prove permanent security identity. Historical candidate-universe acceptance still needs active/inactive membership, ticker reuse, delisting outcomes, observation/revision limits and rights for the selected data source.
recommendation.conditional_paths: Existing Massive/Databento decisions remain alternatives if required identity/revision coverage is missing. WRDS/CRSP is a licensed benchmark option; engine replacement or more repositories cannot supply absent source provenance.
recommendation.registration: Coordinator may register catalogs/us-equities/security-identity-review.json#/decisions. This worker does not edit the central decision index.

limitations: No new native execution or authentication acceptance in this document; consult the coordinator's separate receipt.
Five existing identities and one new conditional identity are reviewed; the broader catalog remains a dated evidence map, not a definitive universal SOTA list.
Code licenses, data entitlements, source truth, temporal availability and trading readiness are distinct.
